# TEKRISE

> TEKRISE is an AI tennis swing analysis app for iOS and Android. A player records or
> uploads a short video of a swing; the app tracks 12 body joints on the device (plus the
> racquet and ball on Android), then returns written AI coaching that names what to fix
> first, a drill plan, and progress tracking over time. It is built for players who train with a coach and for players who
> train alone.

## What it does

- Records or imports a phone video of a tennis swing (forehand, backhand, serve, volley, slice).
- Tracks 12 body joints frame by frame on the device — ML Kit Pose Detection on Android,
  Apple Vision on iOS. On-device racquet and ball detection runs on Android only.
- Sends a silent clip of at most 3 seconds to Google Gemini for coaching analysis. The full
  original recording stays on the phone.
- Returns written AI coaching that names what to fix first, a personalised drill plan, a
  technique score, and per-shot progress trends.
- Coach tools: a coach can review swings a student shares, leave feedback, and see what the
  student practised between lessons.
- Available in 13 languages; the AI coaching reply is returned in the language the app is set to.

## What it is not

- It is not a replacement for a tennis coach. It measures the swing and reports what happened;
  it cannot run live drills, feed balls, read an opponent, or adjust a grip mid-swing.
- It is not a motion-capture lab. Estimates come from a single phone camera, so it is a reliable
  guide to technique patterns and change over time, not a laboratory measurement.

## Pricing

- Free: full AI swing analyses, funded by a short ad. No credit card, no account required.
- Plus: USD 14.90 / month — 10 analyses per day, no ads.
- Pro: USD 29.90 / month — 30 analyses per day, no ads. New subscribers get 50% off the first 3 months.
- Ultra: USD 69.90 / month — 200 analyses per day, no ads.
- Annual plans are available at a discount. Billing is handled by the App Store or Google Play.

## Guides

Measurement-based tennis technique guides, free and open. They apply whether or not
you use the app.

- [Tennis swing faults, measured](https://tekrise.app/guides/tennis-swing-faults):
  every technique fault TEKRISE detects, with the exact body measurement, the healthy
  range (e.g. arm extension 155-175 degrees at contact; peak hip-shoulder separation
  45-55 degrees), the threshold at which it is flagged, and how to fix it. Includes
  which fault to fix first and what the measurements cannot tell you.
- [How to improve your tennis forehand](https://tekrise.app/guides/how-to-improve-your-forehand):
  the five changes that actually improve a club-level forehand, the order to fix them
  in, how to film your swing usefully, and a self-check you can run today.
- [AI tennis swing analysis, explained](https://tekrise.app/guides/ai-tennis-swing-analysis-explained):
  what happens to your video, what phone-based analysis measures reliably, what it
  cannot measure, and an honest comparison with a human coach.
- [How to practise tennis alone](https://tekrise.app/guides/practice-tennis-alone):
  why solo practice often produces no improvement, how to structure a session that
  does, what to do with no partner or court time, and how to track progress.
- [All guides](https://tekrise.app/guides/)
